correctness.rationale: All induced subsets split into peripheral clique unions and their cones. Multiple represented blades force a unique cone apex; the only cross-type overlap is among complete graphs and is explicitly counted by Pascal’s identity. For each type the number of domain sets and automorphisms yields its D class size and rank contribution; stars and bars yields the D class total. Exhaustive independent adjacency/nonadjacency enumeration matched all coefficients in seven small parameter cases, with additional boundary checks, without being used as the universal proof.

value.rationale: The classifies every Green D stratum, maximal subgroup and rank coefficient for all connected generalized windmill graphs, a natural nonhomogeneous family including stars and friendship graphs. Explicit class sizes, count 2 binom(m+s,s)-s, and the rank polynomial give previously unlocated substantive inverse-monoid invariants beyond graph automorphism orders or one finite case; these data distinguish local from global symmetries and compute each rank ideal.
